summary: Inaugural session. Note on honesty of this timestamp: the session began earlier than this entry. The log was instituted mid session, after the first three commits, because the root commit was required to hold the preregistration and nothing else. The three entries that follow record work already committed, and their commit hashes are the verifiable record of when that work landed.

Term gate run before the root commit. Declared queries fixed before their results were read. Verdict recorded: the compound is unoccupied, the two words together sit in the retrieval basin of the conditioning literature, and the source theorem calls the object a matching.
Both cited works resolved and confirmed to exist and to say what this lane was told. Neither read in full. The version suffix of the arXiv record is unverified.

Preregistration written and signed as the root commit, holding that document alone. Question, family, null, statistic, refutation criterion with its own verifiability check, multiplicity rule, disclaimers, sample size and seed.
Contact rules committed. Read only access to the deposited neighbours at their tags, untouchable stays untouchable, the remote recorded as it actually is, third party files under a manifest.

Gates built and tested: dash gate with a single narrow exemption, effort log with a hash chain and session structure checks, figure gate for commit messages backed by a registry, hooks versioned and installable, and a test suite that tries to break each gate.
Background review opened as UNSTARTED with its scope, its queued leads flagged as unread, its standing prohibition on novelty claims, and its closing condition.

Defect found and corrected forward on first run of the dash gate: the gate and its tests carried the forbidden characters as literals in their own source, so the enforcer failed its own rule. Corrected by writing them as codepoint escapes rather than by granting the enforcer an exemption. The history sweep over the three commits made before the gate existed passed clean.

Defect register opened. Two entries: the dash gate carrying the characters it forbids, caught by itself before it landed; and the apparatus commit carrying four documents its message does not describe, caught after it landed and corrected forward rather than rewritten. One known limitation recorded, that the figure gate refuses identifiers as well as figures.

Rigour report for the inaugural session written: commits, files, state of the chain, dash sweep including the retroactive sweep of the commits made before the gate existed, figure gate with its negative test, and the pending decisions that belong to Alexis.

Inaugural session closed. Nothing concerning the family was computed. The preregistration is signed as the root commit, the contact rules and the term gate are recorded, the gates are built and tested and installed, the defect register is open with two entries, and the background review stands unstarted with its prohibition on novelty claims in force.
Session two opened at head 43319e2, working tree clean, gates passing, hooks installed and current. Scope as instructed: name, remote and contracts. No measurement.

Recorded against session one without reopening it: the rigour report of that session counted five commits and did not count the commit that carried the report itself, so a reader at the head of that session sees six. The count is an undercount by one and the enumeration in that report is otherwise correct. Session one stays closed and its report stays as written.

Read only inspection of the neighbours at their tags, no working tree moved. The deposit tag of null-ladder is recorded. The received King Wen sequence was located at the kingwen deposit tag as a named symbol inside a script rather than as a standalone table.

The seven pending questions of session one answered by Alexis and recorded with decider and date. Name adopted, publication authorised, English ratified, the declared asymmetry of the design accepted as deliberate, the source of the received sequence fixed, the figure gate told to distinguish an identifier from a measurement, and the unpublished neighbours made untouchable by repository path and not citable.

Contact rules restated in full. Neighbours are now identified by repository path rather than by a local checkout directory, because a local path identifies an account and is not what the rule is about. The unpublished lane is added with its citation ban written out. The one named exception permitting the received sequence to be copied is written into the rule it bends, with the tension stated.

Two gates. The untouchable gate makes the citation ban executable across tree, history, remotes and config, and distinguishes a mention from a citation. The figure gate learns identifier patterns, each with a stated reason, each counted and printed so nothing passes silently, and with the registry outranking every pattern so a measurement cannot pass as a year. Negative tests run for both.

The received King Wen sequence transcribed mechanically from the neighbour at its deposit tag, checked for length, distinctness and range, written with its provenance and marked as received data never recomputed. The neighbour was confirmed still on its own branch afterwards. The local checkout path is passed on the command line and stored nowhere. While locating it, the deposit was seen to carry an appendix on a ladder of conditional nulls, and a deposited sibling of the same name exists; both are recorded at the top of the background review as the first thing that review must settle, and neither was read.

Pre publication sweep built and run. It reports a finding against the commit that introduced it rather than the newest one carrying it. The working tree is clean. The history is not: the superseded version of the contact rules carries a machine account name in two lines, which is exactly the category the procedure exists to catch, and it cannot be removed without rewriting history. Referred to Alexis before any push.

Two decisions taken by Alexis on the output of the publication procedure. The account name in the superseded blob is accepted and declared rather than removed, with its cost written out, because removing it would break the commit references in this very chain in order to hide something that is not a credential. The history is pushed to the address that exists, since the rename had not been made when the procedure ran.

Publication procedure completed. The remote was confirmed empty immediately before the push. After the push the local and remote heads agree, the tree objects agree, the difference between them is empty, and no commit is held back. The repository is public, so the preregistration now carries a public timestamp.
Rigour report for session two written, enumerating its commits and stating that the commit carrying the report is not among them, which is the practice that came out of the undercount in session one.

Session two closed. Name adopted, remote published and verified, contracts written, gates extended and tested by breaking them, the received sequence loaded with its provenance, and nothing measured. The background review remains unstarted and now carries at its top the lead that could change what this lane is for.
Session three opened at head e19cad1, working tree clean, nothing pending, local and remote in agreement, gates passing. Scope: run the measurement the preregistration declares.

Analysis core written from the signed document alone: the four conventions in the declared order, the matching of the cited theorem by its reverse priority rule, the decomposition into a within-block and a between-block component, this lane's own membership predicate, and the exact sampler with one stream per convention.

Precondition gate run. The adjacency pairing of the received sequence equals the matching of the cited theorem exactly, with empty symmetric difference. The decomposition agrees with the direct count in all four conventions. The recomputed observed statistic reproduces the value the prior lane reported, in two of the four conventions, and the prior lane had stated no convention.

Rung identity confirmed against the deposit read only at its tag. The deposit computes its P1 cardinal by the same expression this lane declared in its signed section on the family, and prints the same figure to the precision this lane declared. Its own definition of that rung is quoted into the record. The family is not this lane's.

Sampler validated by two independent routes before any measurement. The analytic acceptance test the preregistration declares passes in all four conventions, on the mean of the statistic and on the mean and variance of the orientation component. The published predicate of the rung accepts every draw, this lane's independently written predicate agrees with it draw for draw, the published decomposition recovers the choices the sampler made, and four witnesses are classified identically by both. The tolerance the signed document required but did not fix numerically was declared in the code before the run.

The figure gate learns to retire a citation. A cited-unverified record now blocks its token until a superseded record naming that exact token and object retires it, so a figure moves from cited to measured without anything being deleted and without the retirement being guessable. Tested in both directions, including that retiring one object does not retire another with the same digits.

The declared measurement run at the declared seed and sample size over the four conventions, with the decomposition, the exact law for the orientation component, the complement invariance verified, and the Holm correction over the number of tests the signed rule fixes. Reproduced identically on a second run. The verdict was taken against the signed criterion and the branch that was met is named.

Background review moved from unstarted to opened with one item resolved: the family measured here is a rung of a deposited ladder and is not this lane's. Recorded with the consequence that governs every artefact. What that does not settle is stated in the same place.

Two underspecifications of the signed document and one gap in its multiplicity rule declared rather than reinterpreted, each with what was done and what it cost. In the one case where the rule was silent and acting on the finding would have eased the expected outcome, the rule was followed and the finding reported.

Rigour report for session three written, with the order of operations recorded because that order is part of the claim, the three defects declared this session, and the state of the chain, the sweeps and the gates.

Session three closed. The preconditions passed, the family was verified to be a rung of a deposited ladder and not this lane's, the sampler was validated by two routes that could have disagreed, the declared measurement was run at the declared seed and size, and the first branch of the signed refutation criterion was the one that was met. The hypothesis is refuted and the deflation is reported as the result it is. The background review is open and not closed.

Session four opened at head cec26bf, tree clean, gates passing. Scope: close the background review on the one question it has left, by reading the appendix and the ladder material as artefacts and only at their tags. No new measurement.

QUESTION FIXED BEFORE READING, recorded here so that it cannot be adjusted to the answer: does either work measure, on rung P1 or on any rung, the count of discordant pairs of the King Wen sequence against the binary order, or any quantity from which that count follows. Two subsidiary questions, also fixed now: if it measures such a count, under which null and with what result; and if it measures a different statistic under P1, does the discordance count follow from it.

The appendix of the kingwen deposit read entire, in the paper and in the code that produces its table, together with the section defining the pair-preserving null, the results section reporting the counts against the binary order, the ladder material of the other deposit, and the passage of the frozen deposit that names this lane's question. All read only at their tags, no working tree moved.

Term sweep run over every text file at the three tags with the groups declared before the counts were seen. Every file where the statistic vocabulary and the conditional family vocabulary co-occur was opened, since that is the only place the measurement could have been hiding.

Verdict recorded with pointers and verbatim quotation. The measurement was not prior in what was read, but the statistic and its four observed values were, and an inferential evaluation of it against the unrestricted null was. The two nulls share their centre exactly and differ only in dispersion, so the published result already indicated what this one would find. The qualification is written beside the verdict and beside the result, not after them. The limits of the closing are written: three deposits by one author are not the literature.

Rigour report for session four written, with the moment the question was fixed recorded because that ordering is the methodological content of the session, the sweep counts tabulated with the skip stated, and the decision the review has now made possible put in front of Alexis with the deflation visible rather than after it.

Session four closed. The review is closed for the one question it had left: the measurement was not made before in the three deposits read, the observed counts and an evaluation against the unrestricted null were, the two nulls share their centre and differ only in dispersion, and so a published result already indicated what this lane would find. The limits of that closing are written. No novelty is claimed of anything and the review as a whole remains open.

Session five opened at head 5081ca9, working tree clean, gates passing, local and remote in agreement. The signed text is still the blob of the root commit and one commit has ever touched it. This is the last session of this lane.

Forward correction of the two figures the session four report got short by one. That report is not touched. Recorded with its date, with the figures derived from the log rather than typed, and with the note that the apparatus refused a work entry outside an open session, so the correction waited for a session to be opened deliberately.

The closing act written: what was asked and preinscribed with the root commit and the fact that the text was never amended, what was measured and that the signed criterion was met in its first branch, why nothing is deposited with the exact reason and the published sentence quoted, what the review settled and its limits, and that nothing here is cited anywhere and no novelty is claimed.

Three figures registered at closing: the family dispersion and the percentile measured here and therefore usable, and the dispersion under the unrestricted null cited from a prior deposit and therefore refused. The refusal was exercised before the closing commit was written.
Rigour record for the final session, deriving its commit count rather than typing it, which is the practice the correction produced.
